note: Set B binds most values to specific named elevations and captures the artwork note ('SEE ARTWORK PKG FOR SIZE & MOUNT LOCATIONS') plus several correctly located components (TV in C3, MWD01/MWD02 and P2 in the bedroom elevations, 9'-10 1/4" and 3'-6" in North Bedroom). Set A is dominated by unbound or trivial claims — 'Wall section', 'interior elevation', 'identifier W2', 'panel reference P2', 'WB/TV/MWD01 location: interior elevation' — that add little, and it repeats the same dimensions several times. B does misfire more often: it repeatedly conflates A1 South Bedroom with A3 West Bedroom ('SOUTH BEDROOM ELEVATION A3 WEST'), assigns 4 1/2" and 9'-11 1/2" to A3 when they belong to C1/C5, puts 8'-8" in West Bedroom (it is in C5), calls MWD01 a window model, and invents 'center point X'. On balance B's correct, well-bound claims (about 11) far outnumber A's (about 5), while A's failures are mostly vagueness rather than hard misreads.
